items.heading: The Trade Question Comes Second
items.text: The trade question comes second. First decide whether to commit to a trade at 15 or 16 at all.

items.heading: There Is No Single National
items.text: There is no single national polytechnic entry test. Each state runs its own system, and the rules below come from the 2026 cycle. Dates and cut-offs change every year, and most of these figures come from education-news pages, so confirm each one on the state portal before you plan.

items.heading: Students Worry About Getting
items.text: Students worry about getting a seat. The numbers say the harder job is choosing a seat that is worth taking.

figures.source: Maharashtra shows the other side. About 1.03 lakh students took first-year diploma seats in 2025-26, the highest in ten years by the minister's account, partly after AI, data science and robotics diplomas were added. Demand moves with trades, not just with seats.
